dialogues.speaker: Vitusov
dialogues.text: Before coming to Natlan, I was a bit worried that I wouldn't be able to stomach the local food.

dialogues.speaker: Vitusov
dialogues.text: But it seems like I was completely overthinking it! A big, filling, high-calorie meal is just what the doctor ordered.

dialogues.speaker: Vitusov
dialogues.text: Hold on, let me think about this... It's about time I had a go at this limited-time clean plate challenge.
